name: limubert
paper_title: LIMU-BERT: Unleashing the Potential of Unlabeled Data for IMU Sensing Applications
authors: Huatao Xu, Pengfei Zhou, Rui Tan, Mo Li, Guobin Shen
venue: Proceedings of the 19th ACM Conference on Embedded Networked Sensor Systems (SenSys) 2021
notes: Self-supervised 'ConSE tier' baseline with NO released weights: a ~62K-param masked-reconstruction Transformer (BERT-style) pretrained from scratch. We self-pretrain its backbone on the same 18-source training roster as the expanded HALO arm (baselines/limubert/train.py, reusing the upstream SSL pipeline via sys.path) and fit a subject-disjoint softmax head over the current global vocabulary for the zero-shot ConSE bridge. Input contract (verified BASELINES.md): 6-ch acc+gyro, 20 Hz, 120 samples (6 s), acceleration in g (gravity retained), gyro in rad/s, internal LayerNorm. base_v1 architecture: 4-layer (weight-shared), 72-d Transformer encoder.
